column1: # Real SIGNED-return persistence: the variance-ratio cross-section `MarketSim.VarRatioBand` is
# derived from, and `PersistenceAnchorSuite` / `persistence_anchor_tests` re-derive it from.
# Editing a row moves the shipped band. Nothing else is fitted from this file.
# vr(q) = Var(non-overlapping q-session sums) / (q * Var(daily)), sample variances (n-1), the
# series truncated to a whole number of blocks -- `uni.apps.MarketSim.varianceRatio` exactly.
# 1.0 is no serial dependence at that horizon; above 1 is trend, below is mean reversion.
# WHAT THIS FILE SETTLES. Volatility clustering is measured on |r| and is blind to signed
# persistence, so nothing in the target set stopped the model from manufacturing a trend. The
# question a band needs answered is how much signed persistence REAL equity markets carry, and
# the answer is: less than none at three months, consistently, with the ERA separating the
# readings and the index not. Modern series are mildly mean-reverting at q=60 (0.55-1.15 across
# 18 instruments and two windows); the pre-war century is mildly trending (1.14). QQQ 0.720 and
# SPY 0.705 over their full histories are indistinguishable, which is why the band is shared
# across anchor sets rather than carried per asset.
#   wfull  each instrument's full history through 2026-08-03
#   w2001  2001-08-27.. -- the window the depth cross-section in yahoo-2026-08-24.tsv uses
#   c1926/c1954/c1990  CRSP value-weighted US market total return (Mkt-RF + RF), daily, from
#          Ken French's F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily, window opening in that year
# Fund series are daily Yahoo adjusted closes -- the same source and definition as the depth
# cross-section, from a local cache holding 18 of that file's 35 instruments.
